job._mode: Fine-tune from the ChEMBL unconditional pretrained model. The ConditionEncoder and virtual-edge MLP start from random weights; the rest of the GGNN uses the pretrained weights. Update resume_from to point at the actual best checkpoint from Experiment 1.
job._conditioning: condition_dim must match the number of property columns in the preprocessed dataset (4: QED, SA_norm, LogP_norm, GSK3B). condition_embedding_dim should equal hidden_node_features for best performance.
job._training: Lower initial learning rate than unconditional pretraining because we are fine-tuning. accumulation_steps=10 simulates a batch of 10000 subgraphs.
job._architecture: Architecture parameters are ignored when resume_from is set (loaded from checkpoint). Listed here for documentation only.
